files.name: GM-P01-P59-checksum-plugin.dll
files.description: GM P01/P59 checksum plugin - computes correct flash checksums for modified P01/P59 calibrations
files.source: bundled with Phoenix's 2006 P59 XDF downloads (pcmhacking topic 7949)
files.author: Jouko Y (joukoy@gmail.com)
files.notes: Windows PE DLL (11KB, v0.1.1, by Jouko Y - author/version read from the DLL strings). One byte-identical copy was bundled into each of the five 2025-07-17 OS download folders - deduplicated to this single canonical copy. Algorithm-based, no OS whitelist: covers ALL P01/P59 512kB and 1MB bin sizes, not just Phoenix's five OSs - so it applies to the 2004-2005 Car-LS bins (Corvette, GTOs, CTS-Vs) already in the archive. Exports the MMCSCalculateChecksum interface (TunerPro RT checksum-plugin standard). Not for E38 trucks, Duramax or TCMs. Third-party tool: scan before use; the site serves it strictly as a download.
